name: g_ui_substate
meaning: Per-screen sub-state; ==2 forces full frequency redraw

name: g_frame
meaning: Shadow of the last MAIN->SUB status frame: [0] opcode hi (F1/F3/F6/F7/F8/FD), [1] screen id, [9] bit4 dual/alt-layout flag, [0x12] battery level, [0x14..0x17] list index/count (BE16), [0x24] tag show bits, [0x25..0x27] 3-char tag, [0x2D..0x2E] alt meter level/peak, [0x3D..0x4E] mask+16-char text (F1/15), [0x6C] header colour code, [0x8E] screen flags; +0x20/+0x6C band display records
evidence: band_rec_ptr FFEEC3BD; all bandrow_* items; doc pc-04 (opcode shadow)

name: g_band_rec_a
meaning: Band display record (frame+0x20, row type 1/3); fields below are offsets into a record

name: g_band_rec_b
meaning: Band display record for the lower row (frame+0x6C, row type 2)

name: rec_kind
meaning: Display kind: 0 freq, 1 freq+tag, 2 big text, 3 text, 4 tag+big text

name: rec_volsql_sel
meaning: 0 -> label FFED3D9C + bar rec[0x40] (0..31); else label FFECEF7C + bar rec[0x41] (0..15)

name: rec_text_mask
meaning: DBCS mask for text at rec+4 (kind 3)

name: rec_text
meaning: Text (kind 2: 12 chars font20; kind 3: 16-byte mixed; kind 4: 9 chars font20)

name: rec_tag_mask
meaning: DBCS mask for the tag at rec+0x1F

name: rec_tag
meaning: 16-byte tag drawn with the frequency (kind 1/4)

name: rec_freq_blink
meaning: Frequency blink mode: 0 steady, 1 blink all, 2 solid repaint + blinking point

name: rec_freq_bcd
meaning: Frequency, 8 packed-BCD digits, high nibble first

name: rec_icon34
meaning: low7: 1/2/3 icon select, bit7 blink

name: rec_flags3d
meaning: bits0-1 icon F18C/EE9C; bits2-3 icon F13C; bits4-5 icon 2F7C; bits6-7 icon EECC (2-bit show/blink fields)

name: rec_val3e
meaning: 1..10 numeric glyph + suffix, 15 special group

name: rec_comm_mode
meaning: Communication mode 0..0x1B (0x0E..0x1B = blink variants of 7..13); digital class m<4 or 7..10

name: rec_level_a
meaning: Bar value 0..31 (kind 0)

name: rec_level_b
meaning: Bar value 0..15 (kind 1)

name: rec_meter
meaning: Meter level 0..10, bit7 alternate colouring

name: rec_meter_peak
meaning: Meter peak-hold segment (blinks)

name: rec_tone_mode
meaning: Tone mode 0..11 (bit7 blink); 1,2,4,10 CTCSS; 3,9,11 DCS

name: rec_ctcss_idx
meaning: CTCSS index 0..49

name: rec_dcs_idx
meaning: DCS index 0..103

name: rec_flags48
meaning: bits0-1 icon select; bits2-3 APRS tag show/blink; bit4 9600 ("A96") vs 1200 ("A12")

name: rec_dgid_tx
meaning: TX DG-ID 0..99, 0xFF none

name: rec_dgid_rx
meaning: RX DG-ID 0..99, 0xFF none

name: g_redraw_freq_a
meaning: Force full frequency redraw; cleared by freq_draw_digits

name: g_redraw_freq_b
meaning: Same; set after kinds 2-4 overwrite the digit area

name: g_freq_cache_t4
meaning: Digit cache row type 4: [0..7] digit/0xFE blank/0xFF unknown, [8] trailing-00 hidden, [9] point shown

name: g_freq_cache_t13
meaning: Digit cache row types 1/3 (same layout)

name: g_freq_cache_t2
meaning: Digit cache row type 2 (same layout)

name: g_band_row_override
meaning: If != 0xFF, band_row_type() returns it (callers force which row is drawn)

name: g_freq_blinkmode_t4
meaning: Last rec[0x2F] drawn on row type 4

name: g_freq_blinkmode_t13
meaning: Last rec[0x2F] drawn on row types 1/3

name: g_freq_blinkmode_t2
meaning: Last rec[0x2F] drawn on row type 2

name: g_lcd_ctx
meaning: Display context; +0xC framebuffer base (doc 16)

name: g_mode_icons
meaning: Communication-mode icon descriptors [normal/dim][mode]

name: g_blink_tick
meaning: bit0 = UI blink phase (read via 0x68854+4)

name: g_font12
meaning: RGB565 font glyph descriptors, chars 0x21..0x7E, 12-px pitch

name: g_font20
meaning: RGB565 font, 20-px pitch

name: g_font8num
meaning: Small numeric font (0-9 : i k m . -)

name: g_dgid_digits
meaning: DG-ID digit glyphs [style][digit]; styles 2,3 (TX normal/dim), 4 (RX) used

name: g_rec3e_icons
meaning: rec[0x3E] glyphs [dim][v-1]

name: g_tone_glyphs
meaning: Tone/DCS text glyphs (indexed by bytes of FFC3D8C2/FFC3D9BC)

name: g_tonemode_icons
meaning: Tone-mode icons [dim][mode]

name: g_rec48_icons
meaning: rec[0x48] bits0-1 icons [dim][0/1]

name: g_freq_digits
meaning: Ten frequency digit-glyph sets 0x28 apart (68F20..69088); big/small pairs per layout

name: BG_SURFACE
meaning: Background image surface (external bus) used by every erase/restore
